name: 道の駅 鹿島
desc: 国道207号沿いに佇み、壮大な有明海を一望できる「道の駅 鹿島」。新鮮な地元の食材や特産品が並ぶ物産館「千菜市」をはじめ、夏は開放的なBBQ、冬は旬の味が堪能できるカキ焼きなど、四季折々のグルメが楽しめます。さらに、日本一の干満差を誇る干潟の祭典「鹿島ガタリンピック」の開催地としても全国的に知られ、大自然を体感しながら充実したひとときを過ごせる魅力あふれるスポットです。
descEn: Located along National Route 207, "Michi-no-Eki Kashima" offers breathtaking panoramic views of the Ariake Sea. The facility features the "Senaichi" market stocked with fresh local ingredients and specialties, alongside seasonal culinary highlights like open-air BBQ in the summer and delicious grilled oysters in the winter. Well-known as the venue for the famous "Kashima Gatalimpics" held on its dramatic tidal flats—famous for boasting Japan's largest tidal range—it is a fantastic destination to experience magnificent nature and local flavors.
